translations.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (WA)
translations.description: Free, confidential support for anyone in Washington having an emotional crisis. This includes thoughts of suicide or self-harm, depression, anxiety, trauma, or substance use concerns. Call or text 988, or chat online at chat.988lifeline.org. Help is available 24/7 in over 240 languages.
translations.website_description: Call or text 988, or chat online, any time.
